title: How One Cold Shower Teaches a Godly Man to Say No to Himself
caption:
A cold shower won't make you holy. But the five seconds before you step in is a free rep at telling yourself no.

Same voice that negotiates there negotiates at 1 AM. Learn its voice in daylight.

What small thing will you do on purpose tomorrow?

#faith #discipline #selfcontrol #godlymen #christianman #habits
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
